verdict.rationale: Convex documents ACID transactions so concurrent writes stay consistent, and optional schemas that enforce document shape. Queries are TypeScript functions running in the database that can combine multiple reads with arbitrary compute, which implies joins are written by hand in code rather than declared relationally. There is no SQL and no documented join operators or relational constraints such as foreign keys or uniqueness. missing for 10: documented join support or relational query patterns, relational/referential integrity constraints, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-table transactional queries.
